title.text: foo (Rock · Sizzle Rock) — see what it's given and what it does, and steer it

na.text:
A · Local web console
Sees: every stimulus (15-min poll, marketplace event, your message) → Rock's reply → each tool call with ok / failed / uncertain, plus spend, ledger, notes, cost.
Steers: message box (same submit path as the poll), add/remove notes (already in Rock's prompt every turn), pause, run now.
Needs: a 127.0.0.1-only HTTP server inside `pnpm agents` (the store has one owner, so writes go through the host); the page reads the same tables as the SQL we already have.
Can't: change amounts or skip policy limits.

nb.text:
B · Terminal tail + steer
Sees: a live, colour-coded tail of the same timeline in your terminal; sqlite3 -readonly underneath.
Steers: `pnpm steer foo "…"` drops a message, a note or a pause into an inbox the host watches.
Needs: two small scripts + an inbox watcher in run.ts. Smallest diff, no browser.
Can't: approve individual actions; history is scrollback only.

nc.text:
C · Approval gate (copilot)
Sees: a queue of write and money actions Rock wants to take, with arguments and the server-read amount.
Steers: approve / deny / deny with a reason, per action. Gate sits BEFORE Policy reserves, so a deny is a known refusal: spend is released and Rock may try again.
Needs: a park-and-wait step in policy dispatch + the console from A. Strongest control.
Can't: run unattended; slows Rock to your response time.

nd.text:
D · Standing orders + config
Sees: the exact system prompt Rock gets, plus a compact activity list.
Steers: operator orders Rock can't forget (live, next turn), and agent.json goals / dials / limits.
Needs: an operator-notes field beside policy memory; agent.json changes need Save & restart (it's read at startup, strict schema).
Can't: react to one specific event; coarsest control.

title2.text: Chosen: A + D, revised (round 2) — for your approval

nrev.text:
What changed (round 2)
1 Security · Unlock screen: token printed by pnpm agents; header shows "token ok". Raw events render as plain text (see the <b> in the event).
2 Uncertain · "Needs your attention" card: Open task + Mark checked (clears the alert only; the ledger keeps it uncertain).
3 Abandoned · same card: 6 attempts, last error, Run again, Raw event.
4 Readiness · sidebar checklist: wallet balance, unlock file, stream, model, limits (icon + text, not colour alone).
5 Environment · top bar on every screen. Switch it in Tweaks (env): blue development, amber staging, red production.
6 Freeze spending · header button; shows a red band. Blocks post_task and escrow_sign before reserve; reads and messages go on.
7 Pause · header button; shows "3 events waiting" and explains events are stored, not lost.
9 Restart scope · Briefing: Save & reopen foo only (tap keeps running) + a confirm box for limit changes.
12 Raw events · "Raw event" on each event card.
Also: Send carries its own ID, so a double click queues once.
Try: Play on Timeline, click Pause, Freeze, the tool-call badges and Raw event.
